records.rationale: Retain request type, continuous NTB timing/count inputs, PD capability gate, TB prohibition and PD FTMs-per-burst limit four. Default request type is set to INFRA before parse_ftm. Fix ACK unconditional nominal-time dereference: only read a present attribute, retain mandatory presence for PD NTB, and leave legacy infrastructure default zero. Also read AW_DURATION as policy u32 (bounded 255) and FTMS_PER_BURST as u8. The latter width mismatch also exists in native LTS; this corrects access semantics without removing a fix. Accept zero FTMs as documented driver auto-selection even with a nonzero advertised maximum, intentionally relaxing the native nonzero requirement for Android compatibility; upper limits remain, and drivers must choose a supported count. Sanitizer control reproduces ACK null dereference; port passes 1033 cases plus missing-attribute probe.
